meta.name: brand-guidelines
meta.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为作品添加品牌色彩与排版风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为内容快速应用品牌视觉规范。
copy.tagline_en: Apply brand colors and typography to your artifacts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly apply brand visual guidelines to your content.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会使用 Anthropic 官方品牌色（深色、浅色、橙色等）和字体（Poppins 标题、Lora 正文）来美化你生成的文档或图表。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 应用品牌风格、公司设计标准或视觉格式化时触发。

say.text: 用 Anthropic 品牌风格美化这份报告。
say.note: Claude 会应用品牌色和字体。

say.text: 给这个图表加上 Anthropic 的配色。
say.note: 图表元素会使用橙色、蓝色、绿色等强调色。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will apply Anthropic's official brand colors (dark, light, orange, etc.) and fonts (Poppins for headings, Lora for body) to beautify your generated documents or charts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to apply brand style, company design standards, or visual formatting.

say_en.text: Apply Anthropic brand styling to this report.
say_en.note: Claude will apply brand colors and fonts.

say_en.text: Add Anthropic's color scheme to this chart.
say_en.note: Chart elements will use accent colors like orange, blue, green.
